milestones.description: Uses count_in_box_at_most(kind='block', object='crafting_table', max_count=0) to verify the crafting table at its original placement position (~3, ~0, ~3) has been mined. The box is generous (±3 around the placement point) to account for any coordinate drift. This is preferred over inventory_has because after mining the crafting table, the player must re-place it to craft stairs, meaning it won't remain in inventory at final state. Checking the original location ensures the block was removed regardless of where it was re-placed.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted acacia_stairs end up in the player's inventory and are not present in the starting inventory. The recipe yields exactly 4 acacia_stairs from 6 acacia_planks. Since the player starts with 0 acacia_stairs, having >=4 confirms successful crafting. This is the most direct and reliable check for a craft task.
